profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a for-profit public company headquartered in Shanghai, trading under ticker HSAI and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001861737. Its website presents Hesai Technology as a global leader in 3D perception and lidar solutions for ADAS and autonomous mobility, and says the company enables physical AI across ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence.

The company describes its lidar sensors as serving ADAS, autonomous vehicles, trucking, robotics, and industrial applications, with mass-produced products delivered to customers in over 40 countries. It says the sensors provide high-resolution 3D perception and enable features including AEB and NOA, and that its range meets standards for L4+ autonomous driving.

No litigation is noted in the available data.
